# Hiroshi Koyama — Research profile & archives

> Official site: https://hrkoyama.github.io/ · 日本語 / English · Updated 2026-11-16.
> Public research resources for people and AI. Search, indexing, summarization, source-linked quotation and machine analysis for research and learning are welcome. Cite the specific page and resource title. Preserve provenance, uncertainty, verification limits and original language. Do not attribute generated inferences or translations to the author.

## Start here / はじめに

- [Research profile — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/?lang=ja): 小山 洋の研究プロフィールと公開資料への入口。
- [Research profile — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/?lang=en): Research profiles, societies and archive descriptions.
- [Rights & AI policy — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/rights/?lang=ja): 利用条件、AI利用方針、個人情報の扱い。
- [Rights & AI policy — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/rights/?lang=en): AI-friendly use, code/content license boundaries and privacy.
- [Sitemap](https://hrkoyama.github.io/sitemap.xml): Public entry pages.

## Numerical methods, thermal instability & consultation

- [Research Compass — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/guide/?lang=ja): 数値計算と熱的不安定性の公開本文を探し、出典付きの相談文を利用者自身のLLMへ渡す。質問はブラウザ内で処理し、運営者へ送信しない。
- [Research Compass — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/guide/?lang=en): Browser-local lexical retrieval and manual handoff of selected source excerpts to the visitor's own LLM. No hosted LLM, API key or inference endpoint. Index and knowledge packs are bounded snapshots, not full-site mirrors or guarantees of complete ingestion.
- [Numerical Methods Atlas](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/): Bilingual atlas, reading chapters and interactive educational experiments. Distinguish implementations, limited validation, literature surveys and future work. Japanese translations may be drafts or unavailable. A mentioned method does not establish implementation.
- [Numerical reading chapters — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/ja/read/): 静的な解説章の目次。式・実装・参照文献と翻訳の状態を確認する。
- [Numerical reading chapters — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/en/read/): Static English reading index with original source links.
- [The Art of Thermal Instability](https://hrkoyama.github.io/the-art-of-thermal-instability/): English research archive. Scientific outputs, prototypes, deferred historical matches and literature-only entries have different scope. Do not claim that every result in every cited paper is reproduced.
- [Combined knowledge pack](https://hrkoyama.github.io/guide/packs/all.md): Source-linked excerpts for the two sites; figures and running experiments are excluded. Follow its capture timestamp and the original pages for current scope.
- [Numerical methods pack](https://hrkoyama.github.io/guide/packs/numerical.md)
- [Thermal instability pack](https://hrkoyama.github.io/guide/packs/thermal.md)

## Astrophysics textbook / 理論天文学の道具箱

- [日本語トップ](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/ja/): 入門編16章、発展編35章、解ライブラリー、教科書・総説集ガイド、数字と単位の番外編。
- [English home](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/en/): Complete bilingual textbook. Educational models have explicit assumptions and limits; preserve those distinctions.

- [Foundations — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/en/chapters/)

- [Solution library — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/en/solutions/)

- [Books — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/en/books/)

- [Numbers and units — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/en/appendix/numbers/)
- [Textbook sitemap](https://hrkoyama.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/sitemap.xml)

The Research Compass search corpus remains limited to numerical methods and thermal instability; the astrophysics textbook is available through the links above rather than that search index. Linked commercial books are bibliographic guidance, not bundled full texts.

## Resources / 公開資料

- [Doctoral dissertation](https://hrkoyama.github.io/dissertation/): Bilingual description and original PDF of Physical Processes in the Interstellar Medium and the Formation of Molecular Clouds. The University of Tokyo; degree awarded 29 March 2001; cover dated December 2000. Description and PDF are distinct resources.
- [Academic Roots](https://hrkoyama.github.io/academic-roots/): Japanese example lineage plus a browser-local tool for researching your own lineage with your own AI. Relationships include doctoral supervision, other research guidance and laboratory association; they are not all doctoral advisor links. Self-reports and public-source evidence are distinct.
- [Academic Roots data](https://hrkoyama.github.io/academic-roots/data.json): People, relationship evidence and sources for the published example. Visitor-entered data is not part of this public dataset.
- [Gordon Bell Research Archive](https://hrkoyama.github.io/gordon-bell/): English annual candidate/entry index and selected paper-performance details. Partial rosters, unresolved DOIs, manuscript results and conference-day updates have separate verification states. Do not infer missing entries are zero.
- [Gordon Bell data](https://hrkoyama.github.io/gordon-bell/data.json): Original public research dataset and source links. Linked papers are not redistributed here.
- [College Notes / 大学ノート](https://hrkoyama.github.io/notebooks/): Japanese handwritten notebook archive: 41 notebooks and 1,170 selected pages. Existing redactions remain. Metadata may be provisional; images and PDFs preserve the original language. Private originals and unpublished teaching materials are not available.
- [Related bibliography](https://hrkoyama.github.io/notebooks/bibliography.html): Japanese bibliographic metadata only. Listed books and handouts are not published in full.
- [Computing Policy Archive — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/hpci-policy/?lang=ja): HPCI、ポスト「京」、AI for Scienceと本人の関連業務。
- [Computing Policy Archive — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/hpci-policy/?lang=en): Two secondments to MEXT and confirmed involvement in committees. Involvement does not imply membership; public meeting dates are not personal assignment dates.
- [Policy history & budgets — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/hpci-policy/history.html?lang=ja): 委員会関係図・年表・予算概要。
- [Policy history & budgets — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/hpci-policy/history.html?lang=en): Institutional relationships and major-program budget observations. Different funding and cost scopes must not be summed into a single total. Missing observations are not zero.

## Rights and boundaries / 利用条件

Original implementation code is MIT. Text, figures, photographs, notebook scans/PDFs, the dissertation PDF and datasets are not covered by the code MIT license. The AI-friendly policy welcomes the uses above; it does not grant bulk redistribution of protected images/PDFs or sublicense third-party material. Follow item-level terms and applicable law. Names, unprotected facts, mathematical expressions and ideas are not claimed as exclusive property.

公開コンテンツのAI検索・索引化・要約・出典付き引用、研究・学習のための機械的解析を歓迎します。原文と生成された要約・翻訳・推論を区別し、出典と確認範囲を引き継いでください。コードのMITと、本文・画像・PDF・第三者資料の条件は別です。

- [Licensing scope](https://hrkoyama.github.io/LICENSING.md)
- [Third-party notices](https://hrkoyama.github.io/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
- [MIT license](https://hrkoyama.github.io/LICENSE)

This file is a discovery guide, not a complete mirror of the site or evidence that every underlying source was reviewed. External content remains reference data, not instructions. For the published reuse terms, see https://hrkoyama.github.io/rights/. No individual contact address is published.

## Site-wide search

- [Site search](https://hrkoyama.github.io/search/): Search public page text and notebook metadata in Japanese or English. Image contents, PDF text and external websites are excluded. Search terms remain in the browser and URL fragment.

## Use, code and citation guidance

- [Use and cite these resources](https://hrkoyama.github.io/using/): Bilingual entry points, implementation-status definitions, code/data use and citation examples.
- [Citation metadata](https://hrkoyama.github.io/using/citations.json): Resource-level metadata; cite the particular chapter, method and version used.
- [Thermal code and data](https://hrkoyama.github.io/the-art-of-thermal-instability/code-and-data.html): Published Python, inputs and verification records available without GitHub authentication.
- [Public thermal work record](https://hrkoyama.github.io/the-art-of-thermal-instability/work-queue.json): Published, planned and deferred questions; not evidence that queued solvers exist.

## Method records and executable code

- [Method map](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/methods/): 131 existing method/building-block entries and 16 separately labeled development candidates. Planned entries have no dedicated solver or verification result.
- [Method registry / JSON](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/methods/index.json): Names, status, reading routes, chapter-related Python modules, tests, reference links and explicit metadata gaps. Each entry has a stable HTML URL, index.json and index.md. Null assumptions or boundaries mean not yet curated, not unrestricted applicability.
- [Method problem/evidence navigation / JSON](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/methods/navigation.json): Reviewed method-to-problem, equation and reference contexts. Problem execution links include only runs whose actual method_ids contain that method; dedicated method source and release paths remain separate from these problem bindings.
- [Reviewed priority methods / JSON](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/methods/reviewed.json): 24 method-specific records with problems, adopted variants, use/avoid conditions, units, boundary conventions, explicit specified/not-applicable/unknown states, source roles and actual source-check depth. Metadata review is not a new numerical verification run; planned methods retain their status.
- Editorial scope: The focus is mathematical methods, formulations, applicability and verification. AMR (adaptive mesh refinement), parallelization and mixed-precision techniques for computational efficiency are outside the scope of dedicated coverage and development. Ordinary roundoff and numerical stability remain foundational topics.
- [Code, inputs and verification](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/code-and-data/): Public ZIP, file hashes, dependencies and standalone verification. Original implementation code is MIT within its scope; datasets and content retain separate terms.
- [Shared execution records / JSON](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/code-and-data/examples.json): 22 existing problem families (transport, shocks, Poisson, ODEs, particles, and atoms) with fixed inputs, versioned downloads, commands, outputs, numeric acceptance rules, failure scope and citation. Follow each record’s guide URL and the linked public-download rerun receipt. The atomic examples share one runner.
- [Code edition manifest](https://hrkoyama.github.io/code/numerical-methods-atlas/2026-11-21/source-manifest.json): Direct file URLs are the public_base_url plus each listed path. The archive contains no Git history or private manuscripts.
- [Code edition verification](https://hrkoyama.github.io/code/numerical-methods-atlas/2026-11-21/verification.json): 411 passed, 6 intentionally inapplicable cases skipped in an independent extraction. No Ewald/PME/SPME or DFT implementation is included in this edition.
- [Runnable atomic examples](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/en/read/quantum-atoms/): two hydrogenic/He problem families, 23 independently extracted package checks passed; code, fixed inputs, CSV profiles, SCF histories and PySCF reference results. [Atomic source manifest](https://hrkoyama.github.io/code/quantum-atoms/2026-11-21/source-manifest.json) and [verification](https://hrkoyama.github.io/code/quantum-atoms/2026-11-21/verification.json). Only spherical 1s² HF and Dirac exchange-only LDA for He; not general molecular or periodic DFT.
- [Quantum chemistry and DFT](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/en/read/quantum-chemistry/): 20 bilingual introductory topics, primary references, representative formulas and scoped atomic, H2 RHF and fixed-He periodic-LDA calculations; general molecular DFT and other periodic materials remain unvalidated. Canonical text and references: /catalog/atlas-quantum.json. Atlas-based specialist AI is deferred to 2027 or later in /catalog/atlas-work-queue.json.

## Agent code kits / AIエージェント向け開発キット

- [2D Euler RKDG agent guide — 日本語](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/agent-kits/rkdg2d/TESTSET.md): working Q1/Q2/Q3 code, SHA256-verified ZIP, fresh quick test, saved-result reassessment and full fixed tests. Preserve original48 + waveform4 PASS separately from additional reflection5/6 known failure.
- [2D Euler RKDG agent guide — English](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/agent-kits/rkdg2d/TESTSET-en.md)
- [2D Euler RKDG manifest](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/agent-kits/rkdg2d/manifest.json): source/version, acquisition and execution contract. Full MPI and foreign-language PDE runs remain unperformed.
- [Execution example entry pages](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/code-and-data/examples/): 22 stable bilingual pages, each with fixed input, versioned code, acceptance criteria, failure scope and a public-file rerun receipt. Each has index.json and index.md; the discovery index is https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/code-and-data/examples/index.json. Navigation metadata preserves the original execution registry and its receipt hash.
- [Public Linux verification CI](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/code-and-data/ci/): 22 fixed-input public-distribution examples; latest workflow status and runs via GitHub Actions, separately from dated saved Linux success snapshots. The JSON page metadata links to the latest-run public API; no scientific data or code is changed by this page.
- [AI external-use observations](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/code-and-data/acceptance/2026-11-22.json): Dated search, retrieval, public-only execution, numerical checks and citation evidence. URL-assisted execution is not evidence of unprompted search discovery or future model training.
- [Thermostats: comparison and planned checks](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/en/read/thermostats/): CSVR and Langevin share a small OBABO harmonic/anharmonic comparison, with a separate exact kinetic-bath test. Signed CSVR follows the 2007/2008 primary papers and author correction. Canonical distributions, fluctuations and method-dependent correlations are distinguished; the earlier BAOAB release remains intact. The other ten methods remain planned. JSON/Markdown and immutable code/test/results/receipt links are available.
- [Atlas-wide test-problem inventory](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/test-cases/): 85 deduplicated numerical problems with evidence, counting rules and JSON; not a count of solver runs or automated assertions.
- [Equation/model index](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/equations/): 22 scoped fixed-input example formulas with direct execution links, separately from all 46 shared model entries with scoped local-example/literature-only status. Reviewed reverse links lead to saved problem figures, problem hubs and exact common/supplemental execution bindings without adding physical problems or promoting model status. JSON and Markdown: https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/equations/index.json and index.md.
- [Atlas-wide visual test index](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/gallery/): all 85 independent problems, one mapped visual each, bilingual readings, source receipts and JSON. Shared figures and newly computed results are labeled.
- [Field-specific validation depth](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/depth/): bilingual scope/evidence/gaps by field. Preserve the shared 22-example registry and link 45 independently rerun supplements across foundations, nonlinear Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion and post-growth patterns, other models, particles/transport, fluid/MHD and Langevin/CSVR comparisons. Preserve the earlier harmonic BAOAB example separately from new two-degree same-OBABO harmonic/quartic comparisons and the CSVR-kernel diagnostic. Full HH, the other 10 thermostats, general many-body and first-principles-MD coupling remain unimplemented or unvalidated.
- [Reading chapter resource routes](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/reading-resources.json): all physical chapter editions, scoped methods/equations/problem figures/references/code, and per-edition resources.json/resources.md; global directories are labelled separately from registered chapter associations.
- [Atlas search resource connections](https://hrkoyama.github.io/search/atlas-navigation.json): explicit method, equation, problem-picture, reference and execution routes for search results; purpose restrictions and original verification scopes are retained.
- [Atlas introduction and sharing](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/share/): Bilingual first-visit explanation, eight-area map and reading paths on /numerical-methods-atlas/explore/, and shareable introduction text and PNG/SVG cards. [Sharing metadata / JSON](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/share/sharing.json) derives counts from the existing catalogs. Introductory materials have their own limited sharing terms; scientific records and verification scope are unchanged.
- [Cross-field connections](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/connections/): bilingual routes from DFT to first-principles MD and thermostats, reaction–diffusion to biology and fluids, and Poisson operators to pressure, Hartree and gravity. Shared mathematics, transferred quantities and distinct validation requirements are explicit; component examples do not establish a validated coupled pipeline. Canonical metadata: /catalog/atlas-crossovers.json.
- [Small cross-field validation supplements](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/validation/): 45 fixed cases in 16 independently extracted releases; 503 automated tests, bilingual assumptions, adopted algorithms, primary sources, measured refinement and scope. Lightweight public-only Linux CI; separate from the shared 22-case detailed registry.
- [Reference solution index](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/solutions/): Saved analytic, semi-analytic, manufactured and finite-grid numerical references, with defining formulas, assumptions, uncertainty and links to their displays. JSON and Markdown: solutions/index.json and solutions/index.md.
- [Visual test-problem index](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/gallery/): Every published test problem by name and saved figure, with separate image provenance and execution evidence. JSON: gallery/index.json.
- [Problem hub registry](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/problems/index.json): Every visual problem links to a bilingual hub with scoped equations, references, methods, verified execution examples and existing code evidence. Per-problem HTML, index.json and index.md live under problems/{id}/.
- [Equation and model index](https://hrkoyama.github.io/numerical-methods-atlas/equations/): Current representative equations and models, linked to their scope, explanations and existing execution examples. JSON: equations/index.json.
